test_bot_step_without_error: test the bot step without error for each registered bot in bot.BOTS
build_bot_policy: build a bot policy by name using bot.build(name) and return the policy object
get_bot_factory: get a policy factory for a bot by name using bot.get_factory(name)
get_bot_config: get the configuration for a specific bot by name using bot.get_config(name)
assert_policy_compatible: assert a bot policy is compatible with given timestep and action specs
